c74object.name: ear.direct
c74object.digest: Calculate loudspeaker gains for an ADM DirectSpeakers channel with libear (ITU-R BS.2127)
c74object.description: Calculate loudspeaker gains for an ADM DirectSpeakers channel with libear (ITU-R BS.2127). Maps a channel by speaker label, or by nominal position and bounds, onto a BS.2051 layout.

method.name: autocalc
method.description: Set the autocalc attribute. Recalculate and output the gains whenever the metadata changes. When off, send a bang to calculate.

method.name: azimuth
method.description: Set the azimuth attribute. Nominal azimuth of the channel in degrees; 0 is front, positive is anticlockwise.

method.name: bounds
method.digest: Set the position bounds: azimuthMin azimuthMax elevationMin elevationMax [distanceMin distanceMax], or XMin XMax YMin YMax ZMin ZMax when cartesian is on
method.description: Set the position bounds: azimuthMin azimuthMax elevationMin elevationMax [distanceMin distanceMax], or XMin XMax YMin YMax ZMin ZMax when cartesian is on. A loudspeaker within the bounds is used directly. Send without arguments to clear.

method.name: cartesian
method.description: Set the cartesian attribute. Give the nominal position in Cartesian coordinates (x y z in the ADM's cube, as Dolby Atmos masters give their bed channels) instead of azimuth, elevation and distance. Bounds are then XMin XMax YMin YMax ZMin ZMax; switching clears them.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Output the channel names of the layout from the right outlet
method.description: Output the channel names of the layout from the right outlet.

method.name: distance
method.description: Set the distance attribute. Nominal distance of the channel (normally 1).

method.name: elevation
method.description: Set the elevation attribute. Nominal elevation of the channel in degrees.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, such as 0+2+0, 0+5+0, 2+5+0, 4+5+0, 4+9+0, 9+10+3. Send 'layouts' to list all names.

method.name: layouts
method.digest: Output the names of all known layouts from the right outlet
method.description: Output the names of all known layouts from the right outlet.

method.name: lfe
method.description: Set the lfe attribute. Mark the channel as LFE (sets a 120 Hz low-pass frequency element), so it is routed to an LFE loudspeaker only.

method.name: list
method.digest: Set the nominal position: azimuth elevation and optional distance, or x y z when cartesian is on
method.description: Set the nominal position: azimuth elevation and optional distance, or x y z when cartesian is on.

method.name: packformat
method.description: Set the packformat attribute. Optional audioPackFormatID of the pack this channel belongs to, such as AP_00010003; enables pack-specific mapping rules.

method.name: positions
method.digest: Output the nominal loudspeaker positions from the right outlet
method.description: Output the nominal loudspeaker positions from the right outlet.

method.name: speakerlabel
method.digest: Set the speaker labels of the channel, such as M+030 or urn:itu:bs:2051:0:speaker:M+030
method.description: Set the speaker labels of the channel, such as M+030 or urn:itu:bs:2051:0:speaker:M+030. Labels take precedence over the position. Send without arguments to clear.

method.name: x
method.description: Set the x attribute. Cartesian X of the channel (-1 left to 1 right), used when cartesian is on.

method.name: y
method.description: Set the y attribute. Cartesian Y of the channel (-1 back to 1 front), used when cartesian is on.

method.name: z
method.description: Set the z attribute. Cartesian Z of the channel (-1 floor to 1 ceiling), used when cartesian is on.
